Winnifred Eaton Reeve, His Royal Nibs.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/winnifred-eaton-reeve/his-royal-nibs

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Winnifred Eaton Reeve, the author, died 1954.

First publication of the text used: 1925 (SE colophon: 'His Royal Nibs was published in 1925 by Winnifred Eaton Reeve.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1925, before 1931. Under the United States 95-year rule, every publication of 1930 or earlier has been in the public domain since 1 January 2026 at the latest.
- Country of origin: the facts do not point to any country as the country of first publication. The possible countries for an English text by these authors are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each of them has a term of life + 70 years or less for these deaths, so an unknown country, or a simultaneous publication in two of them, changes nothing. The last person to die died in 1954, so the text entered the public domain in each of these countries by 1 January 2025.
